question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?
sql:
-- Calculate median of monthly averages
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
      AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        p2019.prod_id,
        p2019.calendar_month_number,
        p2019.monthly_sales as sales_2019,
        p2020.monthly_sales as sales_2020,
        ((p2020.monthly_sales - p2019.monthly_sales) / p2019.monthly_sales) * p2020.monthly_sales + p2020.monthly_sales as projected_2021_local
    FROM france_sales p2019
    JOIN france_sales p2020 
        ON p2019.prod_id = p2020.prod_id 
        AND p2019.calendar_month_number = p2020.calendar_month_number
        AND p2019.calendar_year = 2019
        AND p2020.calendar_year = 2020
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.prod_id,
        pr.calendar_month_number,
        pr.projected_2021_local * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected pr
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = pr.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) as avg_monthly_usd
    FROM with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
)
SELECT MEDIAN(avg_monthly_usd) as median_monthly_usd
FROM monthly_averages
